title: Rancho Mirage Economic Development
description: Economic profile and development context for Rancho Mirage — the Coachella Valley's highest-income city and anchor of the three-city luxury corridor.
agent_summary: Rancho Mirage is the Coachella Valley's highest-income city, anchoring the three-city luxury corridor with hospitality, golf, healthcare, and the Cotino master-planned community — the valley's primary routing destination for high-net-worth relocation and retreat queries.
